name: Deerfield
title: Deerfield Window Cleaning in Lakeway, Pure Water | CleanzATX
description: Window cleaning for Deerfield, Lakeway homes of 1,500 to 3,000 square feet. A fair price for smaller houses, outside windows $10 each. Text us.
h1_em: Smaller homes, no spots at all.
intro: Deerfield is a small Lakeway neighborhood of three bedroom homes priced from the mid $400Ks. CleanzATX serves smaller homes here with the same pure water system we use on large ones.

paragraphs: Deerfield is a smaller subdivision where homes run from about 1,500 to 3,000 square feet. Most are three bedrooms, and prices range from the mid $400Ks to the $600Ks. No gate and no HOA are listed for the street. For many families, this is one of the more approachable corners of Lakeway.
A smaller house means a smaller bill, but upkeep still matters. Owners who plan to stay for years often want a service that fits a normal budget and a normal schedule.

On a smaller lot, trees and shrubs sit close to the house. Pollen collects heavily during cedar season, from December to February, and during live oak season, in March and April. Webs form quickly where shrubs touch the wall. Leaf litter fills tracks and screens.

Sprinklers on a smaller lot spray nearer to the windows, so mineral spots build up often on the first row of glass. Rinsing with near 0 TDS water dries without film. For spots that have set, hard water removal costs $10 per pane. Screens at $5 each often make a noticeable change on their own.

There is no gate to coordinate. We drive up, set up poles and clean from the ground, and a single story house is quick work. Inside windows are done by hand with squeegees, with drop cloths on the floor. If you also want your driveway or walkway cleaned, flatwork runs $0.18 per square foot for concrete with a $250 minimum, and the surface cleaner makes quick work of it.

A 2,000 square foot home comes to exactly our $200 minimum for exterior windows, and 3,000 square feet comes to about $300. Time outside is about 90 minutes to two hours for a 2,000 square foot home. The full interior and exterior rate is $15 a window.

why: Fair pricing for smaller homes, starting at the $200 minimum.
Screens, tracks and glass handled together in one visit.
Quick single story work with no ladders against the house.
Plans start at 10% off for Twice a Year service.

faq.q: Is $200 the least I will pay?
faq.a: Yes, that is our minimum job. Many homes in Deerfield land right around it, since 2,000 square feet at $0.10 per square foot is $200.

faq.q: Do you take on small jobs?
faq.a: Yes, as long as the job meets the minimum. If you have only a few windows, ask us about adding screens, tracks or a driveway cleaning to reach it.

faq.q: Can I clean just the outside?
faq.a: Of course. Exterior only is $10 per window. Do both sides and it is $15 per window. You can choose what suits your budget.

faq.q: How long will we be at the house?
faq.a: For a 1,500 to 2,000 square foot home, about an hour and a half to two hours outside. The interior takes about 30 minutes per 1,000 square feet.
Yes. Twice a Year takes 10% off. Triannual takes 15% and adds a free yearly screen cleaning, hard water removal on up to 5 windows and the 7 day rain guarantee.
